proposition: The dissertation does not settle whether 18 Rabīʿ I 829 dates the composition or the copying of the R. Shaqq-i Qamar: it calls the treatise 'before 829/1426' in the work lists, 'the beginning of 829/1426' in chapter six, gives the colophon as 28 January 1426 with a note that it may date copying, and gives the same day as 27 February 1426 for the earliest manuscript's copy.

mediation.who: manuscript colophon / copying note as reported by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: three different framings of one date
